study_notes.photo_schedule: south: south unit 2 door, lower and upper window at photo-mapped stations 8.27/10.76/10.27 m from the south corner (ref 1116-ese-front01), so the south court ends before that door as photographed. north: north unit 2 door, lower and upper window at photo-mapped stations 8.33/9.97/8.82 m from the step (ref 1116-ese-front01; the lower window, photographed at 9.73, moves 0.24 m to clear the door trim), so the north court ends before that door as photographed.
